title: Operator Airline & Airport Fact Authoring
outcome: Authorized operators record truthful airline, flight-leg and airport facts against an existing package departure while preserving explicit pending states and existing Makkah/Madinah hotel authority.
actor: Authorized NoorPath operator staff maintaining a private package departure draft.
modules: Catalogue owns package-version travel facts, validation, persistence and concurrency.
Operator web reuses the existing departure workspace and approved NoorPath operator visual language.
Existing Makkah and Madinah hotel authoring remains authoritative and is not duplicated.
External supplier lookup remains behind a future provider integration boundary.
routes: Operator departure authoring -> /operator/departures/{departureId} -> Airline & airport facts.
Airline & airport facts -> /operator/departures/{departureId}/travel-facts -> add, edit, remove and save flight legs.
Travel facts -> Back to package draft or Preview package.
API -> GET/PUT /api/v1/operator/departures/{departureId}/travel-facts with server-resolved operator tenancy.
acceptance: Only an authenticated operator member with administration access can read or write travel facts for that operator's departure.
Cross-operator departure identifiers return safe not-found behavior rather than leaking tenancy.
Draft departures support up to eight ordered flight legs with airline, flight number, departure airport, arrival airport and per-leg confirmation state.
Pending legs may preserve partial known facts; no missing airline, airport or flight fact is invented.
Confirmed legs require airline name, flight number and both airport names/codes before save.
Travel-fact writes use an independent version token and reject stale saves without conflicting with the existing departure composer version.
Ready-for-review and published departures render travel facts read-only.
The existing Makkah and Madinah hotel fields remain the sole accommodation authoring path for this slice.
The operator route exposes loading, empty, error, conflict, saved and locked states with keyboard-safe 44px controls and responsive reflow.
Rendered accessibility, target-size and no-horizontal-overflow checks pass.
Product Owner visually accepts screenshots for the exact final SHA before merge.
exclusions: Google Places, Google Routes, Amadeus or other external airline/airport lookup integration.
Flight schedules, terminals, live status, PNR or ticketing integration.
A second hotel authoring model or inferred hotel claims.
Customer-facing package price-breakdown changes; public projection follows a later governed slice once provider/source rules are approved.
